body:
## Replay harness and scope

Staging: tmp/b6audit/collet69/replay/ (compute_order.py, compile_candidates.py, stageD/Solution.lean, stageD/axiomprobe.lean, stageD_runner.sh, logs/).

Scope: 6474 modules in the proof cone - 3547 of her record (Submissions.hailey_collet_1252270103.*) + 2927 of the vendored OAI baseline/framework (Submissions.openai_baseline.*, including the OAI.SevenEighths namespace and HeckeZeroSupremum), the submission-local Candidate.* trees pruned (they collide across the 26 submissions in her fork and 0 of her proof-cone files import them - verified by the import census: her files import only Submissions.*, Mathlib.*, Lean.*).

Dependencies: the prebuilt tracker .lake tree reused from the verified [Z78G] replay (mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612, plus all tracker framework packages): the PR is 437,002 additions / 0 deletions, so no dependency pin changed from the tree verified for [Z78G] in 0134/0142. Lean v4.34.1 exactly as pinned by her verifier/pins.json (leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1).

Snapshot guard: the replay refuses to run unless the PR-head tarball sha256 equals 8607635a68655484206cb12112605b2734401860d2a597367b5f2cb8b54c5219 (the frozen head ac76d5ef6008d976a7b8f3c1d921af2317e79ce9 pull).

## Results (all at the frozen head)

- Stage C: 6474/6474 modules compiled independently, 0 failures, 0 not started, 3472s wall (same per-module model as the verified Gao replay: lean -j -o per module over the precomputed topological order, 30-minute deadline).
- Stage D1: Solution.lean kernel-compiled - the canonical statements at the exact rational 8747729897/10000000000 in BOTH claimed scopes (zeta: (theta < s.re) -> riemannZeta s != 0 - the SAME mathlib object as the in-tree Z78* modules, object-pin confirmed by her framework's citation of mathlib's riemannZeta_one_ne_zero; all-Dirichlet: pole-excluded LFunction nonvanishing), each proved by her own endpoint declarations. One probe fix on our side: the added bound-comparison needed an explicit (.. : R) ascription for norm_num; this is a probe-side correction, no substance.
- Stage D2: #print axioms on all six endpoint declarations (seed_step, nf_step, beta_bound, hecke_nonvanishing, dirichlet_nonvanishing, zeta_nonvanishing) - every cone is EXACTLY [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. No new axioms. No sorry axioms.
- Stage D3: static sweep - zero 'sorry' tokens across all 3547 record modules.

## Verdict

At the frozen head ac76d5ef, the claim is machine-verified at the same standard the in-tree project has used for every adopted frontier record (0132 [Z78L], 0134 [Z78T], 0142 [Z78G]). The record's mathematical claim - every presented Dirichlet L-function nonzero for Re s > 0.8747729897 (principal pole excluded), with the Riemann-zeta consequence at the same boundary - is thereby independently confirmed in the kernel against the tracker-pinned mathlib. NO RH claim: this remains a zero-exclusion statement in the unverified region, and the in-tree residual face is where the external inputs are silent.

## Remaining adoption gates (provenance discipline)

1. The PR is still DRAFT ('local verification is incomplete') - the frozen head may move before merge. The adopted commit must be re-identity-checked at the MERGED head (if it moved, re-run the replay at the new head - the harness is ready and the run is ~58 minutes).
2. The standalone paper (https://haileystorm.github.io/research/finite-ordinary-source-moments/) still 404s - named provenance is not complete until it publishes.
3. The catalogue record (QRH-Result hailey-collet-1252270103, QRH-Bound 8747729897/10000000000) must appear on the merged board with its genealogy (builds on PR67 two-level affine input).

## Pre-staged in-tree adoption (ready on merge identity)

- New module formal/RhAttack/Z78Collet.lean: colletUpper = 8747729897/10000000000, colletD0max = 3747729897/10000000000, externalZeroFree78Collet named axiom, colletUpper_lt_gao + implication chain collet -> gao -> track -> liu -> Z78 (strictly strengthening [Z78G]), zetaZeroStripCollet, offPairD0leCollet, endpoint restatement.
- RHEnd Part B16: rhend_sliceColletExcl, unifiedCollet endpoints (plain + PT2), unifiedGao_ofCollet bridges; terminal face becomes hOffC : d0 <= 3747729897/10000000000 (shrink gaoD0max - colletD0max = 3.65e-5 below gaoD0max... i.e. 3748087/10^7 - 3747729897/10^10 = 3.57103e-5).
- Cards + docs ledger + watcher anchor update (ADOPTED = 8747729897/10^10, ADOPTED_ID = hailey-collet-1252270103) after adoption.

Face shrink on adoption: the residual d0 face drops from 3748087/10^7 = 0.3748087 to 3747729897/10^10 = 0.3747729897 (delta 3.571e-5, the largest single in-tree face shrink to date - 4.3x the [Z78G] step).
